svg.title: Contexts: what came before, at three lengths
svg.desc: Three contexts of the text 'of data compressio': the last byte, o, is followed by almost any letter; the last three, sio, nearly always by n; the last six, ressio, by n every time they were seen.
svg.text: Contexts: what came before, at three lengths
Guessing the byte after “of data compressio”. A longer context says more, once seen.
